pick.name: GitHub-native + OSS scanners in Actions (Dependabot, Semgrep CE, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner, zizmor)
pick.what: Dependency, SAST, secret and workflow scanning for $0
pick.why: Dependabot is free on all plans; CodeQL/secret scanning free on public repos; OSS scanners cover private repos
pick.free_limits: GitHub Secret Protection ($19/committer) and Code Security ($30/committer) for PRIVATE repos need Team/Enterprise; free on public. OSS tools unlimited.
pick.windows_fit: web + CLIs (all have Windows builds except via Docker for some)
pick.install: pipx install semgrep; pipx install zizmor; winget install --id Gitleaks.Gitleaks -e
pick.license: Semgrep LGPL-2.1; Gitleaks MIT; OSV-Scanner Apache-2.0; zizmor MIT

alts.name: Trivy
alts.free_limits: Unlimited (Apache-2.0). CVE-2026-33634: trivy-action tags 0.0.1-0.34.2 hijacked 2026-03-19/20, setup-trivy tags replaced, malicious trivy v0.69.4 (03-19) and Docker Hub v0.69.5/6 (03-22). Use trivy-action >=0.35.0 (now v0.36.0) pinned to a post-incident SHA; attacker unnamed in advisory

alts.name: Keep core repos public
alts.what: Open-core repos get CodeQL + secret scanning + push protection free

decision: Dependabot + Semgrep + Gitleaks + OSV-Scanner + zizmor in one workflow covers deps, code, secrets and Actions hardening at $0. The 2026 Trivy/trivy-action compromise is why every action must be SHA-pinned (zizmor flags this).

verify.note: GitHub doc confirms Dependabot on all plans, and Secret Protection/Code Security for private repos only on Team/Enterprise Cloud when purchased (that page lists no prices, so $19/$30 is unverified there). Versions: Semgrep v1.182.0 2026-10-20 (PyPI 1.182.1, ships a win_amd64 wheel), Gitleaks v8.30.1, OSV-Scanner v2.7.0 confirmed. zizmor's latest release is v1.31.1 (2026-10-15); 'v1.32.0-rc1' is a pre-release, so recommend stable. The winget ID is Gitleaks.Gitleaks (manifest 8.30.1 exists).
